project.name: DMP :: Connector :: Databricks SQL
project.description: Reads a Databricks SQL warehouse through the Statement Execution API. A statement is submitted asynchronously and polled to completion, then its result is read chunk by chunk — so the warehouse's own division of the result set becomes the run's chunks, and a large query is genuinely parallel rather than a single serial cursor. No JDBC driver, no cluster library, no connection held open across a poll.
